text:
The shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25 is void under the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities, since it may vest only when an afterborn child turns 25 or the land is first used for church purposes, more than 21 years after every life in being at the 1960 conveyance has ended. Striking that interest leaves the friend with a fee simple absolute. Title is in the friend only (A).

CONFIDENCE: 88
